Attachments: nimbus_rto_test_log.pdf (pdf, 1.8MB) | runbook_snapshot.yaml (text, 9 KB)

Short summary (high level):
- RTO: our recent warm-start test (2027-07-30) demonstrates a median warm recovery of ~6m 40s from control-plane failover to accepting production traffic. The attached PDF contains timestamps, callouts, and service-by-service restore times.
- RPO: persistent KV snapshots at 5-minute intervals; snapshot checksums and ingestion offsets included in the test log. We treat successful ingestion of the latest offset as the RPO boundary; typical RPO observed 0-5 minutes depending on cache flush cadence.
- Runbook excerpt: runbook_snapshot.yaml shows the prioritized steps we run during failover, including KV cache refresh, model warm-up (prefix loading), and routing switch details.

Open items:
- We can provide packet captures for the recovery window but prefer to redact internal IPs (happy to provide sanitized artifacts).
- Monica has a trace for KV cache warm-start timings I will ask to include (should add ~30s of additional visibility).

If Nimbus needs a signed attestation, we can provide a short attestation PDF stating the RTO/RPO procedures and that the attached logs are generated from Redwood production test runs. Let me know required signer.

Alex — hi, Monica from Ops here. Adding a few technical clarifications you asked about and attaching a KV-warmtrace file.

Attachments: kv-warmtrace.log (txt, 420 KB)

Notes:
- KV warm-start behavior: on a warm failover we hydrate the in-memory KV cache from the most recent snapshot in parallel with model prefix warm-up. Hydration includes checksum verification; a full warm hydration completes within 20-45s for a 200k-key working set in our standard config. The attached log includes timed markers for snapshot load, checksum verify, and live-cache validation.
- Model warm-up: we prefetch top-10 most common prefixes per model (based on recent traffic distribution) — that prefetch run completes in ~12–18s for the medium-long models in the test.
- RPO measurement: we capture sequence offsets at snapshot time and cross-check with ingestion window in the control plane; the RPO statement in the PDF is derived from those offsets.
- Evidence hygiene: where artifacts contain internal hostnames or instance ids we will provide redacted copies. We keep an unredacted package internally for audit only.

Operational asks for the tabletop/witness:
- Please confirm desired attendee list and whether you need a recorded session or an in-person witness; most customers prefer a 45–60 minute Zoom with a short demo plus Q&A.
- Confirm whether you want the redacted artifacts or the full logs (we can do both; redacted to security@nimbusretail.com is our default).

Happy to jump on a quick pre-call with Nimbus security to walk through the logs before the tabletop.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Manager, Site Reliability Engineering
Redwood Inference
